tours.name: Add a Salary Structure Type
tours.description: Learn how to add a structure type, which sets the pay basis and default schedule shared by a family of salary structures.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to add a structure type, which sets the pay basis and default schedule shared by a family of salary structures.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Structure types are configured in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Structure types are configured in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Payroll app, such as salary structures and structure types.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Payroll app, such as salary structures and structure types.

steps.title: Structure Types
steps.description: A structure type groups salary structures that share the same defaults, such as Employee or Worker. It sets whether pay is monthly or hourly and the default schedule.

description_i18n.en_US: A structure type groups salary structures that share the same defaults, such as Employee or Worker. It sets whether pay is monthly or hourly and the default schedule.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to create a record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a record.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank form.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank form.

steps.title: Name
steps.content: Type the name, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name, then press Tab.

steps.description: Name the type after the group of staff it covers, for example Contract staff. It is chosen when you create a salary structure.

description_i18n.en_US: Name the type after the group of staff it covers, for example Contract staff. It is chosen when you create a salary structure.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the record.

steps.description: Saving creates the structure type. Its defaults, such as the pay basis, can be reviewed on the same form before you create structures with it.

description_i18n.en_US: Saving creates the structure type. Its defaults, such as the pay basis, can be reviewed on the same form before you create structures with it.

steps.title: Saved
steps.content: The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.

steps.description: The breadcrumb shows where you are. Use it to go back to the list.

description_i18n.en_US: The breadcrumb shows where you are. Use it to go back to the list.
